verdict.rationale: Dagster is a data orchestrator, so pushing modeled warehouse data to SaaS tools is a fair axis to judge. The evidence only shows orchestrating ingestion tools (Airbyte, Fivetran, dlt), dbt transformations, and general asset definitions. Nothing documents syncing warehouse data back into CRM, ads, or support tools, or any reverse-ETL integration.

support.subject: As an analytics engineer, I sync modeled warehouse data back into SaaS tools (CRM, ads, support) to activate it where teams work
